'''Varus Logan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and leader of the [[Street Skifters]] who was present on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]], and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3642 BBY]].

==Powers and abilities==
He was a very skilled duelist with a [[Vibroblade]].
